problem_statement: The snippet build system only accepts a single string value for EXTRA_CONF_FILE, EXTRA_DTC_OVERLAY_FILE, and SB_EXTRA_CONF_FILE in snippet.yml files. The new file_list test scenario provides lists of multiple conf and overlay files using YAML list syntax. Before the change, the schema rejects these arrays and the build fails. After the change, the schema accepts arrays and the parser handles them correctly, applying all listed files.

The hidden tests are entirely test-infrastructure (snippet files, Kconfig entries, main.c assertions, testcase.yaml) that verify these two changes work, and all required names are either already in the repository or are test-specific additions the agent does not need to create.
